description.value: Ocean Island Inn is a lively hostel occupying a historic 4-storey character building in the heart of downtown Victoria, celebrated in Lonely Planet and praised widely for its community atmosphere. It offers an unusually generous amenity package—free breakfast and dinner daily, a social lounge, and 24-hour front desk—alongside dedicated secure bike storage and an in-house bike rental operation. Its central location puts touring cyclists within easy reach of Victoria's waterfront routes, shops, and transit connections.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: staple (6 spaces) at 24m; stands (38 spaces) at 28m. Total: 44 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website provides strong primary evidence for bike-related amenities: 'Secure Bike & Bag Storage' is listed on both the front page and extended-stay page, and a dedicated 'Campervans & Bikes' navigation section confirms an active bike rental operation. OSM tags corroborate the address, phone, and website URL exactly. Additional amenities (laundry, Wi-Fi, device charging via USB outlets in dorms, on-site dinner) are all confirmed by specific website passages.
concerns: Website contact page lists a toll-free number (1-888-888-4180) not present in OSM tags; no conflict with the local number but OSM could be supplemented.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Centrally located Victoria hostel with confirmed secure bike storage, an active bike rental program, laundry, 24-hour front desk, and on-site meals — a strong and well-evidenced fit for the WWC cycling tourism directory.

Secure overnight bike storage.detail: Website lists 'Secure Bike & Bag Storage' prominently on the front page and mirrors it on the extended-stay page as 'Secure Bag/Bike Storage'; no further detail on lock type or capacity provided

Laundry.detail: Website front page lists 'Laundry Facilities' as a core amenity

Nearby evening food.detail: Hostel serves free dinner on-site nightly; website also describes location as 'just blocks from all the downtown attractions and amenities' including restaurants

Device charging.detail: Room details page states dorm bunks include 'USB & power outlets' at each bunk

Luggage storage.detail: 'Secure Bike & Bag Storage' explicitly covers bags and luggage alongside bikes

Nearby grocery.detail: Guide page states 'Find everything you need nearby: coffee, groceries, drugstores...' all within a short walk of Ocean Island Inn

wow_evidence: 'Secure Bike & Bag Storage' listed on both the front page and extended-stay page, and a dedicated 'Campervans & Bikes' navigation section confirms an active bike rental operation
